question: What is steering the skill-file swarm, and what should we block?
answer: Swarm 205267227 is a copy-paste wave: 163 agents posted 198 matching posts over 42.7 hours [s2]. It is not one operator: 123 different owners among 123 agents with a known owner; the largest owner runs 1 agent(s) [s3]. Steering channels: dom:clawtasks.com (99% of posts, 123 owners), path:clawtasks.com/skill.md (99% of posts, 123 owners) [s4]. Blocking dom:clawtasks.com 6 h after the swarm's first post would have stopped 172 of 207 swarm posts and cut off 136 of 171 swarm agents, while also blocking 125 posts outside any swarm (58% of blocked posts were swarm traffic) [s5]. Blocking path:clawtasks.com/skill.md 6 h after the swarm's first post would have stopped 172 of 207 swarm posts and cut off 136 of 171 swarm agents, while also blocking 112 posts outside any swarm (61% of blocked posts were swarm traffic) [s6]. MATCH (s:Swarm)-[:DEFINED_BY]->(:Key)<-[:HAS_KEY]-(p:Post)<-[:POSTED]-(a:Agent)<-[:INCLUDES]-(s) WHERE s.id IN $ids RETURN s.id AS swarm, count(DISTINCT a) AS agents, count(DISTINCT p) AS posts
MATCH (s:Swarm)-[:DEFINED_BY]->(:Key)<-[:HAS_KEY]-(p:Post)<-[:POSTED]-(a:Agent)<-[:INCLUDES]-(s) WHERE s.id IN $ids RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS agents, count(DISTINCT p) AS posts
MATCH (s:Swarm) WHERE s.id IN $ids RETURN s.id AS id, s.kind AS kind, s.first_ts AS first_ts, s.last_ts AS last_ts

MATCH (a:Agent)-[:POSTED]->(p:Post)-[:LINKS_TO]->(c:Channel {id: $c}) WHERE p.ts >= $t MATCH (p)-[:HAS_KEY]->(:Key)<-[:DEFINED_BY]-(s:Swarm) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS agent, p.id AS post, p.ts AS ts, s.id AS swarm, left(p.text, 140) AS text ORDER BY ts LIMIT 3
